bundled_components.description: Automation (including persistent-success recovery, zero-routine-permission linked-draft editing, visible workers, and the default all-green stop-before-Run-Agents endpoint), factory, submission-pool, and solver-rule skills with all references, scripts, and assets
Claude Code project skill adapters, runtime mapping, and per-slot/supervisor subagents; all adapters load the canonical bundled skills rather than duplicating policy
Claude Code project instructions, setup guide, visible Playwright browser bridge, and validated auto-mode launcher
Durable controller, state, tests, audit tools, and internal skill validator
Living rules, checkpoints, templates, and previous-review memory
Lightweight registry metadata for ownership, source, novelty, and duplicate checks; bulky pilot evidence is intentionally excluded
Accepted challenge examples used for audits
Platform challenge archive used for duplicate checks
Empty Git-ignored runtime root for future challenge packages
Empty Git-ignored runtime scratch root for downloads, revisions, recovery, and browser-bridge records

runtime_requirements: Python available as py or python
Node.js 20+ when using Claude Code browser automation
